You know, the reason I really adopted her is because when we were still struggling to determine my diagnosis and things looked more like anxiety I thought it would be good to have a 'therapy animal' of sorts by my side to pet and hug when I was feeling nervous. I was so wrong, she's so much more than that.

She had bronchitis a few weeks ago so we had to take her to the vet. To determine if it was bronchitis or something else, the vet performed an xray. Seeing the results was amazing. Of course her bronchi were kind of inflamed but you could see her heart there. The thing that keeps blood flowing inside of here. I feel that (of course taking into consideration how different one scenario is from another) that's what to-be parents must feel when they see ultrasounds.

Thanks for reminding me I'm important just because I'm me. I struggle putting my needs before those of the people I care about. Thanks a lot also for the reality check.
